headline: Daewoo Myoung climbs to 40th on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Daewoo Myoung gained 6.39 points to reach 42.92, moving from 64th to 40th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The climb puts Myoung among the board’s top 40 teams; the last of 16 gold places is 16th at 61.81.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
